test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The football match was being watched by the boys.

options.text: The football match was watching the boys.
The boys had been watching the football match.
The boys were watching the football match.
The boys are watching the football match.

solution: The correct answer is **'The boys were watching the football match.'** ***__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Active Form. • The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: • Subject + was/were + V1+ing +Object. (Active Voice) • Subject(Objective Case) + was/were + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *He was riding a bike.* • *A bike was being ridden by him. * • Here, in the given sentence 'was being watched' will be changed into 'were watching'. • The conjunction 'by' will be removed. • 'The boys' will be changed into the subject. ​Correct Sentence:__ The boys were watching the football match.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य **Passive Voice** में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को** Active form **में बदलना है। • दिया गया वाक्य **'past continuous'** का उदाहरण है। • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: • Subject +was/were + V1+ing +Object. (Active Voice) • Subject(Objective Case)+was/were+ being+ V3+ by +Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *He was riding a bike.* • *A bike was being ridden by him. * • यहां, दिए गए वाक्य में** 'was being watched' **को** 'were watching' **में बदल दिया जाएगा। • **Conjunction 'by'** हटा दिया जाएगा। • **'The boys'** को **subject** में बदल दिया जाएगा। be:T1226, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
